item_name: Rothco Reflective Elastic PT Physical Training Belt
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Reflective PT Physical Training Belt is the ideal choice for workout enthusiasts who prioritize safety while exercising in low-light conditions. Hi-vis design features a reflective silver line running through the middle, this belt ensures you remain visible in the dark, enhancing your safety during night workouts or runs. The non-restrictive elastic material allows for maximum flexibility and comfort, making it perfect for high-impact activities. The belt measures 48 inch x 1.75 inch, providing a comfortable fit for most users.
description: Rothco’s Reflective PT Physical Training Belt is the ideal choice for workout enthusiasts who prioritize safety while exercising in low-light conditions. With its blend of visibility, comfort, and ease of use, this belt is a must-have for anyone who enjoys exercising outdoors, especially in low-light conditions.
